Resolves #20492

Demo B's keyboard policy now lives in the example-owned `DemoBKeyboardHost` prototype mixin. The workspace retains its command instance, state, listener/lifecycle ownership and three small facades for semantic IDs, labels and grammar. Its file shrinks from 3,440 to 3,134 lines; the new module is 376 lines. Engine KeyboardCommands remains the cycle/terminal owner, and callbacks still resolve current host methods.

Related: #15614

Evidence: L2 (unit regression) plus headed native browser witnesses on macOS 27.2 → same behavior required. Residual: none for this extraction. The operator-observed existing popup styling defect is out of scope, noted in #20493 and owned separately by Sophie.

## Deltas from ticket

No substantive change. The three facade methods pass static host facts into the extracted implementations; all other methods retain their names on the host through the existing Neo mixin mechanism.
